title: ARDRA: Amplified rDNA Restriction Analysis
author: Eva Petrova
materials: Tubes were incubated in a thermocycler overnight.

steps.title: Prepare colony PCR mix
steps.instruction: Assemble a 12 µL PCR reaction using Hy Labs' Taq polymerase (follow the manufacturer’s recommended buffer, dNTPs, primers, and MgCl₂ concentrations). Add the DNA template by gently poking a single colony with a sterile pipette tip and mixing the tip into the reaction; do not use wooden toothpicks.

steps.title: Amplify rDNA by PCR
steps.instruction: Run the 12 µL PCR tube in a thermal cycler using the appropriate cycling program for the chosen primers (program not specified in the source).

steps.title: Verify PCR product on 1% gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 % agarose gel in 1 X TBE, load 3–4 µL of the PCR product, and run the gel to confirm successful amplification, leaving roughly 5–8 µL of product in the tube for downstream digestion.

steps.title: Digest PCR product with TaqI
steps.instruction: Transfer 5–10 µL of the PCR reaction (depending on amplification yield) to a new tube, add 20 U of TaqI restriction enzyme, and add the enzyme’s supplied buffer and water in the volumes recommended by the manufacturer. Mix gently and incubate under the conditions specified by the enzyme supplier (temperature and time not provided).

steps.title: Prepare 3% agarose gels
steps.instruction: Make two 3 % low‑melting agarose gels in 1 X TBE: for the large gel dissolve 7.5 g agarose in 250 mL TBE; for the small gel dissolve 3 g agarose in 100 mL TBE. Heat until fully melted, pour into the appropriate gel trays (25 × 15 cm for the large gel, 10 × 15 cm for the small gel), and allow to solidify for 30 min at room temperature followed by 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the TaqI‑digested samples onto the solidified gels. Run the small gel at 70 V for 3 hours and the large gel at 90 V for 5 hours.

steps.title: Post‑stain gels and visualize
steps.instruction: After electrophoresis, incubate each gel for 20 min in 1 X TBE containing ethidium bromide (EB) at a concentration of 10 µL of a 10 mg/mL EB stock per 100 mL of buffer. Then visualize the DNA bands under UV light.
